approvalEvidence.instructionVerbatim:
I explicitly approve the governed Build 27 campaign using application and backend source baseline commit `2ab554d143bd778cfa1b4d9ab2ed3c35cf62b056`.
I approve deploying the existing 15-function fleet to production project `crm3-baf-ops-b8638`, region `asia-south1`, using the existing dedicated service accounts, `PreserveExistingIam`, and App Check enforcement remaining false. The scheduled function may be deployed but must not be manually invoked.
I approve strict live readback of the unchanged Firestore Rules SHA-256 `823877B9B03F8D4E2687532615F5037A9742F3AA224AE209BC2C7A866F845E04` and unchanged 66-index set SHA-256 `E58BEAEF69212C4B00035C120F345D25F962588EE84ACC6D88363CD5EE2D95A4`; neither rules nor indexes are to be redeployed.
After successful readback, I approve creating, pushing, reviewing and merging the necessary backend-reconciliation and Build 27 governance changes, provided review and CI are clean. I approve allocating and constructing production-signed Build 27 (`1.0.0-rc.17+27`) from the exact resulting `main` commit, followed by independent package verification, dual custody, copying the verified APK to Downloads, and installing it on the attached phone as an in-place upgrade preserving all app data.
No IAM change, App Check activation, production business-data mutation or deletion, scheduler invocation, device-data clearing, wider distribution, Play Store publication, or unrestricted publication is authorized.
approvalEvidence.instructionSummary: Deploy and strictly read back exact Build 27 backend source, then construct, verify, retain and install one protected Build 27 after clean review and CI.
approvalEvidence.scopeInterpretation: The instruction authorizes one exact Build 27 protected signing run, independent verification, dual custody, a Downloads copy and one attached-phone in-place installation preserving app data. It does not authorize manual scheduler invocation, business-data mutation, device-data clearing, wider distribution or publication.

authorityBasis: The owner's explicit Build 27 instruction is bound to exact PR 355 source and its successful post-merge release gate. The existing required-reviewer protection is retained and this record does not itself release signing secrets; production signing still requires the protected run approval event.

singleOperatorConstraint.interpretation: The required-reviewer rule creates a deliberate approval event and prevents unattended secret release; it is not represented as independent two-person approval.

failClosedConditions: Valid only for Build 27 and dispatch reference BAF-REF-003-C26.
The source freeze 2ab554d143bd778cfa1b4d9ab2ed3c35cf62b056 must be an ancestor of the exact admitted dispatch commit, with artifact-affecting paths unchanged.
The actor and triggering actor must match the authorized dispatcher; the required reviewer must explicitly approve the protected run.
The public repository, main-only environment and disabled administrator bypass must remain unchanged.

Only the verified APK may be copied to Downloads and installed once on the attached phone as an in-place upgrade preserving app data; no wider distribution, device-data clearing or business-record mutation is authorized.
expiresWhen: Build 27 has a verified remote built tag or the governed repository/environment state differs, whichever occurs first.
